title: Eleusinian mysteries and earlier Minoan and Mycenaean forms

tellings.quote: Brian mirescu who wrote you know the immortality key he talks about the linian mystery rituals much later obviously in Greece

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points to Brian Muraresku, author of a book called The Immortality Key, who writes about the Eleusinian mysteries, secret religious rituals of ancient Greece. Michels places these rituals much later than the earlier Minoan and Mycenaean cultures of the region, and he tells it as part of an idea that the rites carried forward something from a far older past.
